newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil shrs end slightly off, seen erratic Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Brazil shrs end slightly off, seen erratic Tuesday.

text.p: Brazilian shares closed slightly down as apathy remained ahead of a slow week due to October's municipal elections, brokers said.
The Sao Paulo bourse's Bovespa index of the 49 most traded shares dropped 0.19 percent, closing at 64,469 points, in sluggish trade and analysts believe Tuesday will be pretty much the same.
Market turnover was a moderate 315.1 million reais ($309.3 million), with bellwether Telebras preferred, which fell 0.37 percent to 80.30 reais, leading trade.
Even a rise in the Dow Jones index failed to cheer investors here, brokers said.
While most blue-chips fell, oil state firm Petrobras percent to 119.99 reais.

Analysts said Petrobras stocks were still reflecting the firm's recent discovery of oil 1,709 meters below the water's surface, a national record. The discovery adds 150 million barrels to the companys's reserves.
The Sao Paulo bourse's power sector index (IEE), comprising the nine most liquid shares of the sector, rose 1.01 percent to 1,619 points.
